description: This file defines classes and methods for integrating Spark features into pandas-on-Spark DataFrames and Series, including schema inspection, caching, and transformation utilities. It is part of the pandas-on-Spark library's Spark accessor implementation.

classes.name: SparkIndexOpsMethods
classes.description: Abstract base class providing Spark-related operations for pandas-on-Spark Index objects.

classes.name: SparkSeriesMethods
classes.description: Provides Spark-related methods for pandas-on-Spark Series, including apply and analyzed.

classes.name: SparkIndexMethods
classes.description: Provides Spark-related methods for pandas-on-Spark Index, including analyzed.

classes.name: SparkFrameMethods
classes.description: Provides Spark-related methods for pandas-on-Spark DataFrame, including schema, print_schema, and conversion to Spark DataFrame.

classes.name: CachedSparkFrameMethods
classes.description: Extends SparkFrameMethods with cache management features for cached DataFrames.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the underlying Spark schema of the DataFrame.

methods.name: print_schema
methods.description: Prints the Spark schema in a tree format.

methods.name: frame
methods.description: Returns the current pandas-on-Spark DataFrame as a Spark DataFrame, optionally with index columns.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Caches the DataFrame and returns a CachedDataFrame object.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Caches the DataFrame with a specified StorageLevel.

methods.name: hint
methods.description: Adds a hint to the Spark DataFrame for query optimization.

methods.name: to_table
methods.description: Writes the DataFrame into a Spark table.

methods.name: to_spark_io
methods.description: Writes the DataFrame out to a Spark data source.

methods.name: explain
methods.description: Prints the Spark logical and physical plans for debugging.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a function to the Spark DataFrame, returning a pandas-on-Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: repartition
methods.description: Repartitions the DataFrame into a specified number of partitions.

methods.name: coalesce
methods.description: Reduces the number of partitions of the DataFrame.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.description: Returns a checkpointed version of the DataFrame to truncate the logical plan.

methods.name: local_checkpoint
methods.description: Returns a locally checkpointed version of the DataFrame.

methods.name: analyzed
methods.description: Returns a new DataFrame with an analyzed Spark plan to optimize performance.

methods.name: storage_level
methods.description: Returns the storage level of a cached DataFrame.
